newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: IMF mission to visit Uzbekistan to review loan.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission to visit Uzbekistan to review loan.

text.p: A mission of the International Monetary Fund, which has suspended assistance to Uzbekistan, was scheduled to arrive in the Central Asian state on Thursday to review its economic performance, an IMF official said.

"The mission is arriving to update the macroeconomic picture of 1996 and discuss relations between the IMF and Uzbek government in 1997," Mark O'Brien, the fund's resident representative in Uzbekistan, told Reuters.
Relations between the IMF and the resource-rich former Soviet republic cooled at the end of last year and the fund stopped disbursing a $185-million stand-by loan.
